applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Miscellaneous) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must note the deletion of Section C on 'Limits for Non-Option Derivative Contracts' in Chapter IV.
answer.action_quote: Section C on ‘Limits for Non -Option Derivative Contracts’ of Chapter IV of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Miscellaneous) Directions, 2025 (paragraph 37 of the Directions) stands deleted.

effective_date.quote: The amended instructions shall come into effect immediately upon issuance.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Miscellaneous) Directions, 2025
